name: JLCPCB
notes: Values from the Rigid PCB capabilities page (1-32 layers). Extra cost: holes < 0.3 mm (help article) / 0.1-0.15 mm holes and 0.2-0.25 mm holes with via pad < 0.45 mm (capabilities page); multilayer trace/space 3.0-3.5 mil (+20% for 4-8 layers, +30% for 10+); 2 oz copper itself is a paid option. 0.1/0.2 mm vias only for boards <= 1 mm thick with ENIG/OSP. Inner copper is 0.5 oz by default.

value_notes.via_drill: Standard price: help article says holes < 0.3 mm cost extra ('cost is higher than that of standard holes (with a diameter of >= 0.3mm)'). Capabilities page rule 3 is looser: '0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more' (so 0.2/0.45 may also be standard price). 0.3 kept as the safe value.
value_notes.via_annular_ring: 'Via diameter should be 0.1mm (0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size' -> 0.05 min, 0.075 preferred; profile uses the preferred 0.075 (0.3/0.45).
value_notes.hole_to_hole: 'Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.2mm'; 'Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing 0.45mm' (PTH pads). Value is the via figure.
value_notes.hole_to_copper: 'Via hole to Track 0.2mm'; 'PTH to Track 0.28mm (0.35mm is recommended)'; 'NPTH to Track 0.2mm'. Value is the via/NPTH figure; PTH needs 0.28.
value_notes.edge_clearance: Routed edge >= 0.2 mm; V-cut edge >= 0.4 mm; castellated hole to board edge >= 1 mm (sic, as published).
value_notes.mask_bridge: 1 oz: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple), 0.13 mm (black, white).
value_notes.mask_expansion: 'Soldermask Expansion 1:1' (LDI since June 2025); keep >= 0.09 mm between mask openings and neighbouring traces.
value_notes.pth_drill: Holes < 0.3 mm cost extra (help article). Page recommends PTH >= 0.5 mm 'to avoid soldermask or tin stuck in the hole'.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: 'SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets) 0.15mm'; pad to track 0.1 mm.
value_notes.max_drill: Drill range up to 6.3 mm; larger holes are CNC routed.
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: 2-layer 1 oz: 'Recommended 0.25 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.18 mm'.
